module: Slip provider (type "auxiliary", defaultOrder 70, providerOrder 10) that compares each wheel's speed to the vehicle's virtual speed (virtualSensors.virtual.speed) to estimate slip. It registers with the tractionControl and absControl supervisors (if present) and answers them via calculateSlipTractionControl and calculateSlipABSControl. The results are written into the supervisor's wheel structures (wheelData.slip, wheelGroup.maxSlip/minSlip/slipRange).
notes: Traction slip = clamp((wheelSpeed + offset) / (virtualSpeed + offset) - 1, 0, 0.5) * coefficient, smoothed by wheelData.slipSmoother. The coefficient is the minimum of: torque coefficient (motor throttle, 0..0.01 -> 0..1), the supervisor's steeringCoef, and the virtualSpeed confidence (0.5..0.8 -> 0..1). The wheel speed is corrected by vehicleData.turningCircleSpeedRatios.
ABS slip = absolute value of (ratio - 1) bounded to 0.5, multiplied by the speed confidence, also smoothed.

Modifiable parameters: tractionControl.isEnabled, absControl.isEnabled. When traction control is disabled, the slips are reset to 0 and calculateSlipTractionControl returns false (the next provider is then tried).
No jbeam key is read. The provider depends on CMU.virtualSensors and CMU.vehicleData.

providerOrder.desc: Priority order among the providers (10, lower = tried first).

initSecondStage.desc: Registers as a slip provider with tractionControl and absControl.

updateGFX.desc: Empty (debug version: sends the enabled state).

calculateSlipTractionControl.desc: Computes the slip of each wheel of a powered group and the group's extremes. Called by tractionControl.

wheelGroup.desc: Wheel group {motor, wheels, wheelCount, maxSlip, minSlip, slipRange}.

velocityOffset.desc: Speed offset (m/s) avoiding division by ~0 at low speed.

returns.desc: True if the slip was computed, false if disabled.

calculateSlipABSControl.desc: Computes the slip (as an absolute value) of a single wheel for the ABS. Called by the absControl supervisor.

returns.desc: True if the slip was computed, false if disabled.

registerCMU.desc: Stores the reference to the CMU.

getConfig.desc: Returns a copy of the configuration.

sendConfigData.desc: Sends the configuration to the CMU.
